newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE May white sugar freight differentials.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE May white sugar freight differentials.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) issued new freight differentials for its white sugar contract to cover the May delivery period.

The exchange notice showed the following premiums - Penang, Port Kelang, Singapore $2 a tonne (zero in March), Inchon $8 ($6), Ulsan $6 ($4), Bangkok/Kohsichang $3 ($1), Laemchabang $3 (zero), Guangzhou, Huangpu, Shekou and Xiamen all $5 ($3), Recife and Maceio $6 ($3), Santos $13 ($10), Imbituba/Itajai $11 ($8), Buenos Aires $11 ($8), New Orleans $12 ($8), Savannah $12 ($8), Matanzas $16 ($12) and Durban $4 ($1 discount).
